description: This file is a test class for acceptance testing in a SuiteCRM project. It contains setup methods and a test scenario to verify the visibility of a due date field in the History subpanel within the Accounts module. The test script automates UI interactions such as login, navigation, record creation, and deletion, utilizing Faker for generating test data.

classes.name: HistoryCest
classes.description: Acceptance test class for verifying the due date display in the History subpanel of Accounts module.

methods.name: _before
methods.description: Setup method run before each test, initializes Faker generator and seeds it with a random seed.

methods.name: testSeeDueDateSubpanelView
methods.description: Test scenario that creates an account and call, verifies the due date in the subpanel, and then cleans up by deleting created records.
